in_sanskrit.name: अन्तर्वाश
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The inner driving force, the deepest desire that motivates and guides an individual. It represents the soul's true intent and the inner voice that inspires one's actions.

in_marathi.name: Antarvash
in_marathi.long_meaning: Antarvash हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Refers to the inner self or inner consciousness. Derived from the words 'antar' (inner) and 'vas' (abode).
